values.note: The county says 20 sites; the booking engine lists 17 (2, 4-18 and 20). Site 17 is 12 x 24 ft, 'for small campers or pop-ups only'; site 20's power post is about 20 ft from the site.

sites.source: https://www.fdlcountyparks.com/parks/camping/fairgrounds__rv_park/ ('20 RV & Travel Trailer sites are located north of the Grandstand Area'); site_17 ('The site is for small campers or pop-ups only.' 'Dimensions: 12' wide x 24' deep'); site_20 ('Power is located approximately 20 feet from the site')

values.note: Bathrooms and showers are opened on request during office hours only (Mon-Fri 7 am-3:30 pm).

facilities.source: https://www.fdlcountyparks.com/parks/camping/fairgrounds__rv_park/site_11/ ('Bathrooms/showers are ONLY available upon request and during normal business hours (Monday thru Friday - 7am to 3:30pm).')

values.note: From the booking calendar (reservations are the only way in): 2027 nights Apr 15-Oct 14 are bookable, none in Nov-Jan; site water is off about Oct 15-Apr 20. Closed to camping from the Sunday before the mid-July county fair to the Friday after.

season.source: https://www.fdlcountyparks.com/parks/camping/fairgrounds__rv_park/availability/ (Apr 14 2027 'x', Apr 15-16 'o'; Oct 13-14 2027 'o', Oct 15-16 'x'; Jan 15-17 2027 and Nov 19-20 2026 all 'x'); campground page ('All reservations must be made online 3 days prior or by calling'; 'Water is turned off to sites from approximately Oct 15 - April 20'; 'Camping is not available from the Sunday before the Fond du Lac County Fair to the Friday following the fair.')

values.note: No same-day reservations: book online or by phone to the Fairgrounds office (920-929-3169, Mon-Fri 7-3) at least 3 days ahead.

booking.source: https://www.fdlcountyparks.com/parks/camping/fairgrounds__rv_park/ ('14-Night Maximum Stay'; 'We do not take same day reservations. All reservations must be made online 3 days prior or by calling the Fairgrounds office during business hours.'); availability calendar for 2027

note: Fond du Lac County Fairgrounds RV park, a row of sites north of the grandstand. Rents ordinary nights all season except fair week (mid-July); a few outdoor music events at the fairgrounds can run all day. No tents; dirt bikes, snowmobiles and ATVs are not allowed. --Claude
summary: County engine: $40/night + $5 reservation fee, all sites 30/50A W/S, 20 sites (engine lists 17; site 17 is pop-up only), 14-night max, 3 days' notice, bookable Apr 15-Oct 14 (stored year_round contradicted by the calendar), closed fair week. Not waterfront kept.
flags: Fairgrounds test: passes. The county sells ordinary nights to the public all season ('Camping is not available from the Sunday before the Fond du Lac County Fair to the Friday following the fair'); the 2027 calendar shows open nights in April, June and October.
SEASON: stored year_round (derived from the old note) replaced with Apr 15-Oct 14 from the booking calendar; reservations are the only way to camp here, and no night is bookable Oct 15-Apr 14.
WEBSITE: stored first line https://www.fdlco.wi.gov/... is on a domain that refuses (403, known); not read. The fdlcountyparks.com page is the live booking page.
PHONE 920-929-3169 (Fairgrounds office) confirmed on the booking page.
Fit: site 17 is 24 ft deep, pop-ups only; the other site pages give no dimensions. No campground-wide limit; a 23-ft rig should fit the ordinary sites.
Pin 43.7644,-88.4290 is on the RV strip between the fairground parking lots; kept. Not waterfront kept (no water near the sites; stormwater ponds 250 m west).
